s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent painful skin lesions with ulceration and systemic inflammation
salient_findings: Painful pimple-like bumps on bilateral lower legs
Ulcers with central eschars and dusky gray borders
key_facts: Patient is a young black woman
Presented with chills and bilateral lower extremity swelling
Recent course of trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole for MSSA
Medical history includes methimazole and atenolol
Pitting edema and multiple discrete, round, dry ulcers on lower legs
Elevated CRP and ESR
Normal C3 and C4 complement levels
ANA titer 1:80
P-ANCA titer 1:20
Anti-myeloperoxidase (MPO) titer 141 U
Anti-SSA/Ro antibodies level 120 U
Initial punch biopsy showed lymphohistiocytic infiltrate with neutrophils and focal abscess
Second biopsy showed intraepidermal and dermal perivascular neutrophilic infiltrate with necrosis of vessel walls

differentials: Vasculitis associated with systemic lupus erythematosus
Tumor necrosis factor receptor-associated periodic syndrome
per_call: Vasculitis associated with systemic lupus erythematosus
Tumor necrosis factor receptor-associated periodic syndrome

shortlist.label: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated ANCA titer and presence of systemic inflammation

shortlist.label: Erythema induratum
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent painful skin lesions with ulceration and systemic inflammation

shortlist.label: Leukocytoclastic vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of neutrophilic infiltrate and necrosis of vessel walls

shortlist.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic inflammation and presence of painful skin lesions

shortlist.label: Microscopic polyangiitis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated ANCA titer and presence of systemic inflammation

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with painful lesions, pitting edema, and multiple discrete ulcers, along with laboratory findings of elevated CRP and ESR, and histopathological evidence of intraepidermal and dermal perivascular neutrophilic infiltrate with necrosis of vessel walls, is most consistent with leukocytoclastic vasculitis.

rejected.label: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
rejected.why: Lack of granulomatous inflammation on biopsy

rejected.label: Erythema induratum
rejected.why: Typically presents with recurrent nodules on the calves, not discrete ulcers

rejected.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
rejected.why: Usually involves medium-sized arteries, not small vessels as seen in this patient

rejected.label: Microscopic polyangiitis
rejected.why: Typically presents with renal involvement and pulmonary hemorrhage, not seen in this patient
